newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian PM has influenza, cancels Canada trip.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian PM has influenza, cancels Canada trip.

text.p: Hungarian Prime Minister Gyula Horn has been stricken by influenza and has had to cancel a four-day official trip to Canada, government officials said on Wednesday.
Horn, who was to have begun his trip on February 9, will set a new date after consulting the Canadian government, the prime minister's office told the state-run MTI news agency.
Nine people have died of influenza in Hungary in the past week, bringing the number of fatalities to 19 in the past few weeks, MTI reported. Seventeen of those who died were over 60, the agency said.
It quoted health statistics as showing that 61,735 influenza cases had been registered throughout the country, a sharp increase from the week before.
